hints.content: A prime number has exactly two factors: $1$ and itself.

The factors of $25$ are $1, 5,$ and $25.$

$25$ has $3$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $26$ are $1, 2, 13,$ and $26.$

$26$ has $4$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $35$ are $1, 5, 7,$ and $35.$

$35$ has $4$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $39$ are $1, 3, 13,$ and $39.$

$39$ has $4$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $43$ are $1$ and $43.$

$43$ has **exactly** two factors so it is a prime number.
